Bertocci Auth0 RFC 9068 JSON Web Token (JWT) Profile for OAuth 2. 0 Access Tokens Abstract This specification defines a profile for issuing OAuth 2. 0 access tokens in JSON Web Token (JWT) format. Authorization servers and resource servers from different vendors can leverage this profile to issue and consume access tokens in an interoperable manner. ¶ Copyright Notice Copyright (c) 2021 IETF Trust and the persons identified as the document authors.
